name: Brotherhood of Northshire
summary: At Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest, the Brotherhood of Northshire guides the faithful and trains new defenders. Once called the Clerics of Northshire, the order was rebuilt after its losses in the First War.

sections.title: The Clerics of the First War
sections.body:
Centuries ago, missionaries from Lordaeron traveled south and founded Northshire Abbey in Stormwind. They served its people through the Holy Light and sought to soothe the realm. First called the Holy Order of Northshire Clerics, they showed compassion even to injured gnolls and jungle trolls during past border wars.

When the Orcish Horde crossed the Dark Portal, the clerics went unarmed and without armor to heal fallen soldiers. Their healing sustained the Stormwind Army, so the orcs made them targets. The order was decimated, and the abbey was ransacked and burned. The surviving clerics fled north across the sea to Southshore with Sir Anduin Lothar.

sections.title: The Spark of the Paladins
sections.body: The slaughter of Northshire’s clerics shook the human kingdoms. Archbishop Alonsus Faol saw that faith alone could not withstand an axe without armor and martial discipline. He joined surviving clerics with devout knights to form the Knights of the Silver Hand. These warriors bore the Light’s sacred power and a knight’s skill in battle. Northshire’s fallen healers laid the foundation for the holy warriors who broke the Horde in the Second War.

sections.title: Rebuilding and Present Duty
sections.body: After Stormwind was reclaimed and the Dark Portal destroyed, Archbishop Faol rebuilt Northshire Abbey and reorganized the order as the Brotherhood of Northshire. Today, the abbey is a quiet place where new recruits begin their service to the realm. Priestess Anetta, Brother Sammuel, and Brother Paxton help tend the valley’s spiritual needs, preserve ancient texts in the library, and train defenders against brigands, wolves, and the gathering shadows across Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: What is the Brotherhood of Northshire?
aliases: who are the brotherhood of northshire
faq.answer: The Brotherhood of Northshire is a monastic order of the Church of the Holy Light based at Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest. Once called the Clerics of Northshire, its members offer spiritual guidance, heal the wounded, and train new Alliance defenders.

faq.q: What happened to the original clerics during the First War?
faq.answer: The clerics entered the First War as unarmored battlefield healers, and their healing sustained the Stormwind Army. The orcs targeted them, and the abbey was overrun and ruined. Only a remnant escaped across the Great Sea to Lordaeron.

faq.q: How did the Northshire Clerics inspire the paladins?
faq.answer: Archbishop Alonsus Faol saw that unarmored clerics could not survive brutal combat. He joined their devotion to the Light with the martial skill of knights and formed the Knights of the Silver Hand.

faq.q: Who leads or trains people at Northshire Abbey today?
faq.answer: Brother Paxton manages provisions and copies texts for the library. Priestess Anetta instructs aspiring priests, and Brother Sammuel guides novice paladins at the abbey.

faq.q: What was the expedition to the Deadmines during the First War?
faq.answer: An ogre chieftain named Turok stole Northshire’s sacred Tome of Divinity. Sir Anduin Lothar led an expedition into the Deadmines of Westfall to retrieve it, but became trapped until Stormwind forces rescued him and returned the book to the abbey.

faq.q: Are they connected to the Defias Brotherhood?
faq.answer: No. Though both groups share the word “brotherhood,” the Brotherhood of Northshire is a holy order loyal to Stormwind. The Defias Brotherhood is a criminal band of outlaws and bandits who plague the countryside.

angles.text: As a priest, you find Northshire Abbey at the heart of Stormwind’s clerical tradition. Its people cultivated healing, confession, and the Holy Light long before the First War.
As a paladin, you carry a legacy born from the butchery of Northshire’s unarmored clerics. Their deaths drove Archbishop Faol to create the Knights of the Silver Hand.
As a human, you inherit a tradition that has brought spiritual comfort to generations of Stormwind citizens. Northshire Abbey is also the humble beginning of the kingdom’s greatest champions.
